confirm.title: Call a blow-out?
confirm.lead: This cancels {tripTitle} and sends every booked diver one message: what happened, where their money stands, and the upcoming departures they already qualify for, as booking links.
confirm.moneyNote: Card payments go back automatically. Anything taken at the counter, or on a card DiveDay can’t reach, stays with you to return, and those divers are told a refund is owed.
confirm.diversHeading: {count, plural, one {# diver will be messaged} other {# divers will be messaged}}
confirm.noEmail: No email — flagged for a call
confirm.noDivers: Nobody is booked on this departure. Calling it cancels the trip
confirm.departed: This departure is underway or has left, so there is nothing to blow out.
confirm.moneyNoteHeld: Card payments aren’t sent back from here: an owner or manager releases the refunds, and those divers are told a refund is owed. Anything taken at the counter stays with you to return.

record.title: Cancellation record
record.noOffers: No qualifying dates, so the schedule was sent instead
record.heldHeading: {count, plural, one {# payment is still held.} other {# payments are still held.}}
record.heldRelease: Card payments go back to the card. Anything taken at the counter is yours to return.
record.heldWaiting: An owner or manager releases the card refunds. The divers have been told a refund is owed.
record.empty: No divers were booked when the blow-out was called
record.offeredCount: {count, plural, one {# offered departure} other {# offered departures}}

notices.called: Blow-out called. The trip is canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.
notices.refundsReleased: Card refunds sent. Anything that couldn’t go back still shows as owed under Orders.
notices.refundNotAuthorized: Only an owner or manager sends refunds.
notices.departed: This departure is underway or has left, so nothing was canceled.
notices.error: Nothing was canceled: this departure was deleted or couldn’t be read just now. Open it from the schedule to check it, then call the blow-out again.
notices.dayCalled: {count, plural, one {Blow-out called. The departure is canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.} other {Blow-out called on # departures. They are canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.}}
notices.dayPartly: {called, plural, one {# departure called.} other {# departures called.}} {skipped, plural, one {# couldn’t be called: already left or no longer scheduled.} other {# couldn’t be called: already left or no longer scheduled.}}
notices.dayNone: Select at least one departure to call.

day.title: Call a blow-out for the day?
day.lead: This cancels every departure you select and sends each booked diver one message, the same as calling each one on its own. Nobody is offered another departure this call cancels, and the crew of each one hear at once.
day.booked: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody booked} one {# booked} other {# booked}}
day.nothingToCall: Nothing left to call on this day
day.instead: Calling the whole day? Call several departures at once
day.confirmButton: {departures, plural, one {Cancel # departure} other {Cancel # departures}}, {divers, plural, one {# diver} other {# divers}}

recovery.boundary: Follow-up records the diver’s choice. Refunds and messages keep their own status.
recovery.bookingUnavailable: The linked booking is no longer available for recovery. Check the diver’s plans.
recovery.stale: Someone updated this diver’s follow-up. Review the latest history and try again.
recovery.invalid: Follow-up was not saved. Check the selection and the diver’s existing bookings.
recovery.busy: Recovery is being updated. Try again in a moment.
recovery.creditBoundary: Goodwill credit is separate from any refund. An owner or manager can grant promotional credit on the diver’s record.

alternatives.title: Prioritize shore or pool departures (optional)
alternatives.help: Choose up to three. Eligible choices lead each diver’s booking links; no seats or facilities are reserved. Unavailable choices are left out.
alternatives.limit: Three selected. Clear a choice to select another.
alternatives.invalid: Choose up to three existing shore or pool departures. Nothing was canceled.

classroom.heading: Classroom activity
classroom.boundary: Complimentary · No diving or course credit. The original refund process continues.
classroom.cancelConsequence: Confirmed places become unavailable. Prepared offers remain on record. Contact affected divers through your existing channels.
classroom.places: {count, plural, one {# confirmed} other {# confirmed}} · {capacity, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}
classroom.offer: Complimentary classroom activity: {title}. {start} to {end}. Meet at {location}. No diving or course credit. Your original refund process continues. Ask the shop to confirm a place.
classroom.manualContact: Relay this message through your usual channel. Ask the diver to contact the shop; no online request is available.
classroom.title: Activity title
classroom.attest: Room and coordinator confirmed. I have checked the arrangements for this time.
classroom.invalid: Check the activity details. No place was confirmed.
classroom.not_authorized: Your current role cannot manage this activity.
classroom.not_found: This cancellation or activity is unavailable.
classroom.stale: The activity changed. Refresh and review before trying again. No place was confirmed.
classroom.unavailable: The activity, coordinator, or diver is unavailable. No place was confirmed.
classroom.full: The place limit would be exceeded. No place was confirmed.
classroom.busy: Another change is in progress. Try again. No place was confirmed.
classroom.already_prepared: An offer is already prepared for this diver.
classroom.conflict: This coordinator has another classroom activity at the same time. Review the arrangements.
classroom.uncertain: Connection lost. Check the activity, then retry.
